text: Attempt 14: attempt 13's start (best first six years) with the low taxes of attempts 2 and 4 (4-5%, tax controller capped at 6%), shops held to ~1/3 of homes, homes away from plants, loans for land as in 2 and 4; first target: beat 35,690.

Attempt 13 peaked at 20,070: its tax rule pushed factory tax to 12% and industry collapsed. Across all 13 attempts the two biggest cities ran 4-5% taxes, so attempt 14 keeps taxes low and borrows to grow, then deals with debt at 30,000+.
